title: Can one declared jurisdiction and zone support dated activity, and which historical calendars are licensed for Northwind/Pubs periods?
owner: bounded calendar researcher then separate reconciler
resolution:
Open: nonblocking to architecture, mandatory before the affected integration. One supported division/zone journey; no global holiday scrape. Preserve out-of-coverage negatives. Expected payoff: S3, future workforce and mobility.

Phase3 root-acceptance binding: remains OPEN and blocks phases4/5/6 completion for the affected selected scenario. It does not block work on unrelated accepted paths. Closure requires dedicated semantic decisions and source/legal/coverage evidence for the scoped integration, or an explicit root-reviewed narrower portfolio with retained rejected/deferred paths. A source observation alone cannot close this question.
